findings.name: raw_equal_v
findings.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define (pack cells color)
    (let ((rs (map first cells)) (cs (map second cells))
          (us (map (lambda (p) (+ (first p) (second p))) cells))
          (vs (map (lambda (p) (- (first p) (second p))) cells)))
      (list color cells (apply min rs) (apply max rs) (apply min cs) (apply max cs)
            (apply min us) (apply max us) (apply min vs) (apply max vs) (remove-duplicates vs))))
  (define (from-object o) (pack (obj-cells o) (obj-color o)))
  (define (boundary? o) (or (= (list-ref o 2) 0) (= (list-ref o 4) 0)
                           (= (list-ref o 3) (- (rows g) 1)) (= (list-ref o 5) (- (cols g) 1))))
  (define (fill-boxes objs)
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((o (in-list objs)))
      (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g) (lambda (r c)
        (if (and (= (at out r c) 0) (<= (list-ref o 2) r) (<= r (list-ref o 3))
                 (<= (list-ref o 4) c) (<= c (list-ref o 5))) 7 (at out r c))))))
  (define (xlo o) (list-ref o 6))
  (define (xhi o) (list-ref o 7))
  (define (ylo o) (list-ref o 8))
  (define (yhi o) (list-ref o 9))
  (let* ((raw (objects-8 g 0)) (original (map from-object raw))
         (all-cells (apply append (map obj-cells raw)))
         (colors (sort (remove-duplicates (map obj-color raw)) <))
         (selected original) (base (fill-boxes selected)) (bridge-objs selected))
    
      (for*/fold ((out base)) ((a (in-list bridge-objs)) (b (in-list bridge-objs)))
        (if (and (< (xhi a) (xlo b))
                 (<= (max (ylo a) (ylo b)) (min (yhi a) (yhi b))) #t)
            (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g) (lambda (r c)
              (if (and (= (at out r c) 0) (< (xhi a) (+ r c)) (< (+ r c) (xlo b))
                       (<= (max (ylo a) (ylo b)) (- r c)) (<= (- r c) (min (yhi a) (yhi b)))
                       (and (member (- r c) (list-ref a 10)) (member (- r c) (list-ref b 10)))) 7 (at out r c))))
            out)))))

limits: Three executable hypotheses on one generated two-demo/four-query episode; pre-repair evidence, not final qualification.
program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define original-objects (objects-8 g 0))
  (define (extent obj)
    (let* ((us (map (lambda (p) (+ (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells obj)))
           (vs (map (lambda (p) (- (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells obj))))
      (list (apply min us) (apply max us) (apply min vs) (apply max vs))))
  (define spans (map extent original-objects))
  (define gaps
    (filter (lambda (span) (and (< (first span) (second span))
                               (<= (third span) (fourth span))))
      (for*/list ((a (in-list spans)) (b (in-list spans)))
        (list (second a) (first b)
              (max (third a) (third b)) (min (fourth a) (fourth b))))))
  (define base (fill-object-bboxes-8 g 7))
  (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
    (lambda (r c)
      (if (and (= (at g r c) 0)
               (for/or ((span (in-list gaps)))
                 (and (< (first span) (+ r c)) (< (+ r c) (second span))
                      (<= (third span) (- r c)) (<= (- r c) (fourth span)))))
          7 (at base r c))))))
